title: InventoryItemReservation - Data API
description: Used to store inventory item reservation information for a specific product and location. This object is available in API version 60.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled. ISO code for the currency of the inventory items. Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

ErrorCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorCode.description: The error code if the reservation isn’t successful.

ErrorMessage.description: If an error occurred, this field contains the error message.

InventoryItemReservationName.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
InventoryItemReservationName.description: Name of the inventory item reservation (autogenerated, for example: PIR-0033).

InventoryReservationId.description: The ID of the inventory reservation. This field is a relationship field.

ItemReservationSourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ItemReservationSourceId.description: The ID of the entity associated with the inventory item reservation. This field is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

ProductId.description: The ID of the product on the inventory item reservation. This field is unique within your organization. This field is a relationship field.

Quantity.description: Number of products on the inventory item reservation.

ReservedAtLocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReservedAtLocationId.description: The location or location group where the inventory item reservation originated. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

StockKeepingUnit.description: The stock keeping unit (SKU) of the reserved item.
